CustomField.description: Populated by analytics. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Tmq9WAwxRrHvpPukwBT0Ty3TdB9NJE9Z16kVgdXjH1U/edit?usp=sharing S3P-1330 - Created as part of Customer Health Score initiative. A score from 0 to 100 indicating overall account health. Calculated based on Fill Rate, Tenure, Monthly Spend (and spend change), Return Requests, Product Count, and Lead Quality. Accounts opened within the last 90 days will be blank (too new to score). This field is automatically populated by Analytics.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A score from 0 to 100 indicating overall account health (Red: 0-29, Yellow: 30-69, Green: 70 - 100). Calculated based on Fill Rate, Tenure, Monthly Spend (and spend change), Return Requests, Product Count, and Lead Quality. Accounts opened within the last 90 days will be blank (too new to score). This field is automatically populated by Analytics.
CustomField.label: Customer Health Score
